stimulus.title: Changes during secondary succession after farmland abandonment
stimulus.description: The same temperate site was surveyed at intervals after agricultural use stopped.

question: Calculate the percentage increase in plant species richness from year 1 to year 35, and explain two processes that could account for the changes shown during succession.
markscheme: Pioneer and later-arriving species colonize the site over time, increasing species richness as conditions and available niches change.
Accumulation of litter and decomposition adds organic matter to the soil and can improve water and nutrient retention.
Increasing vegetation height reflects establishment of shrubs and trees and greater biomass/structural complexity as succession proceeds.
markschemeJa: 時間とともに先駆種や後から侵入する種が定着し、環境条件や利用可能なニッチが変化することで種数が増える。
落葉・枯死体の蓄積と分解によって土壌有機物が増え、水分・栄養塩保持能力が改善しうる。
植生高の増加は、遷移の進行に伴う低木・樹木の定着やバイオマス・構造的複雑性の増加を示す。
modelAnswer: Species richness increased by ((38 − 8) ÷ 8) × 100 = 375%. During succession, additional species colonize as habitat structure and environmental conditions change. Litter accumulation and decomposition increase soil organic matter, improving soil conditions. The rise in vegetation height indicates replacement of early low-growing vegetation by taller shrubs and trees as biomass and structural complexity increase.
modelAnswerJa: 種数の増加率は((38−8)÷8)×100=375%です。遷移が進むと、生息地構造や環境条件の変化に伴って新たな種が定着します。落葉・枯死体の蓄積と分解により土壌有機物も増えます。植生高の増加は、初期の低い植生から低木・樹木へ移行し、バイオマスと構造的複雑性が増していることを示します。
